head: 55e573949537f392c6e0d427af1dca6783d2474c
body:
The bounded independent adjudication confirms that **original F1 remains
unresolved** at `55e573949537f392c6e0d427af1dca6783d2474c`. The operator hold
and failing `local-review/summary` remain. F2, the incompatible telemetry
writer/lock, is fixed.

Fresh Astra/xhigh adjudicator Gauss compared issue #502, original review
[5194195608](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/507#pullrequestreview-5194195608),
the new approval and MAIN's earlier
[disposition](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/507#issuecomment-5660459454).
That disposition explicitly retained the atomic member-ref requirement and
rejected leased no-op pushes and a frozen-snapshot interpretation as substitutes.
The new approval's admitted residual race therefore does not discharge F1.

A deterministic local bare-remote fixture exercised byte-identical candidate
train/push code. Git advertised member H and main B; the client sent only the
main B-to-T command with `atomic`. A receive hook then advanced the member to
a pre-existing descendant R before main committed. Publication still exited
success with main T and member R. Packet traces, hook ref snapshots and the
publication receipt establish the ordering. The earlier transport-start test
also passed, showing that the two timing cases differ. No live refs or GitHub
records were changed by the adjudicator.

The unchanged member refspec is omitted from the server transaction. Its lease
checks advertisement, while atomicity covers only the transmitted main update.
An additional client check or post-push observation does not implement the
required member comparisons in main's transaction.

Disposition: keep train publication inactive and continue the existing
individual-PR merge path. Landing this behavior requires either an equivalent
server-enforced atomic guard, or an explicit authorized contract amendment
accepting member movement after advertisement, with accurate wording and tests.
The latter changes the previously accepted requirement; it is not a repair of
F1. No new transport framework, protection change or scope exception is granted.

The report, both isolated race probes, raw prior records and source bindings are
archived in `results/telemetry/native-audits/pr507-publication-adjudication-01a0afd6/terminal.jsonl`.
All 57 manifest entries were hash-verified. The task completed in 566.243 seconds
within budget and retired. This is an operator disposition of the existing
finding, not a new full review; earlier reviews, approvals and costs are preserved.
